required_runtime_rules: Do not use TinyFish for isolated novel generation.
Do not use old Opera Browser Connector.
Always create a new ChatGPT tab for a fresh writer run; do not reuse an existing ChatGPT conversation.
Send the complete multiline prompt with one fill operation, then click Send separately.
Do not use type_text plus Enter for multiline prompts because embedded newlines may trigger premature sends.
Wait until generation is complete before reading the response.
Do not modify the returned prose before repository storage.
known_operational_risks: A new ChatGPT tab may be redirected by login state; verify the final page is a usable authenticated ChatGPT session before sending.
A stale UI spinner is not evidence of incomplete external work; verify durable repository/output evidence before retrying.
next_action: The Opera Neon executor chat must take the already-returned A3 prose from its own current conversation and store it verbatim into state/inbox/PHASE397_NS01_RENDERER_CANDIDATE_A3.txt. Do not regenerate A3 unless that prose is genuinely unavailable.
